steps.label: drag down far with the mouse
press Escape on the simple drawer

allowed.match: ^focus \| dialog( "[^"]*")? \[drawer-popup\] in drawer \| generic \[drawer-popup\] in drawer \|
allowed.reason: the drawer keeps the native <dialog> as the dialog (role, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby) and puts no role on the popup; the live site puts role=dialog on a div popup

allowed.match: ^(drawer|dialog) accessible description \| Make changes to your profile here\. Click save when you're done\. \| None \|
allowed.reason: the drawer keeps the native <dialog> as the dialog (role, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby) and puts no role on the popup; the live site puts role=dialog on a div popup

allowed.match: ^ARIA tree \(dialog\) \| \d+ nodes \| \d+ nodes \| shadcn only: dialog( "Edit profile")?$
allowed.reason: the drawer keeps the native <dialog> as the dialog (role, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby) and puts no role on the popup; the live site puts role=dialog on a div popup
Firefox focus ring: Base UI moves focus after the key event (here after the exit animation), so Firefox paints no focus ring there; the kit keeps the keyboard focus ring
